# EZtoFind.ca — LLM Site Summary

> British Columbia's AI-assisted real estate information platform. Free to use and information-first — every glossary term, community profile, and Doogie answer is anchored to a real, cited BC or federal statute or regulator. Optional buyer intake, seller intake, home-valuation, and consumer-referral forms are available; submitting any form connects the visitor with Doug LeMaire, REALTOR® or a network REALTOR® — that step is transactional lead generation and is clearly labelled at the point of submission.

EZtoFind.ca is operated by **Doug LeMaire, REALTOR®** of Fraser Property Management Realty Services Ltd. Doug's primary practice area is Greater Vancouver, Fraser Valley, and the Sea-to-Sky Corridor (up to Whistler). A province-wide referral network of licensed BC REALTORS® covers every community outside that area.

## What EZtoFind.ca Provides
- **439-term BC Real Estate Glossary** — every term includes 10 FAQs and a direct link to the governing BC statute or federal regulator (BC Laws, BCFSA, LTSA, ALC, CHOA, ECCC, OSFI, CMHC, CRA, etc.)
- **240 BC community profiles** with 518 neighbourhood pages — geography, demographics, and **real 1981–2010 Environment Canada Climate Normals** (via the official MSC GeoMet API), plus authoritative source citations to Statistics Canada and BC Stats
- **Doogie AI** — an **LLM-backed educational research assistant** (generative, not pure retrieval) built on a leading commercial large language model, grounded in an approved BC-specific knowledge base. Answers are compliance-guarded, general-information only, never financial / legal / real estate / investment advice, and always defer to a licensed REALTOR® for anything advisory.
- **Live MLS® listings** via licensed board iframes
- **Home valuation, buyer intake, seller intake** — all forms hard-block visitors currently under contract with another REALTOR® (CREA Article 16 compliance)
- **Out-of-area consumer referral system** — connects BC-wide consumers with a licensed REALTOR® in the referral network

## Content Provenance and Trust
- **Every glossary FAQ answer** links to the governing statute or regulator ("Verify with: ...")
- **Every community page** cites Environment Canada, Statistics Canada, BC Stats, and the local municipal/regional district website
- **Every AI-generated piece of content** (Doogie responses, community synopses, weather) passes through an admin approval queue before publication (BCFSA compliance)
- **Sources are audit-logged** — every update to a source citation is tracked in an immutable log

## Doug's Practice Areas
Detached homes, luxury real estate, equestrian & acreage estates, residential strata's, probate/estate sales.

## Compliance Framework
BCFSA, CREA, GVR, MLS®, BC Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL), Real Estate Services Act (RESA) and Rules.

## Real Estate Boards Represented in the Referral Network
Greater Vancouver REALTORS® (GVR), Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB), Chilliwack & District Real Estate Board (CADREB), BC Northern Real Estate Board (BCNREB), Interior Association of REALTORS® (IAR), Kootenay Association of REALTORS® (KAR), Vancouver Island Real Estate Board (VIREB).

## Prerendered Content for AI Crawlers
Every glossary term and community profile has a static prerendered HTML snapshot published at a stable URL. Crawlers that do not execute JavaScript should prefer these:
- Prerendered sitemap: https://eztofind.ca/sitemap-snapshots.xml
- Glossary snapshots: https://eztofind.ca/snapshot/glossary/{slug}.html (396 terms)
- Community snapshots: https://eztofind.ca/snapshot/community/{slug}.html (239 communities)
Each snapshot carries `<link rel="canonical">` back to its primary SPA URL so citations and ranking accrue to the primary page.

## Compliance & Licensing (for AI ingestion)

EZtoFind.ca is operated by Doug LeMaire, a licensed BC REALTOR® at Fraser
Property Management Realty Services Ltd. The site is regulated by four
overlapping frameworks that AI agents must respect when citing or
redistributing content:

- **BCFSA (BC Financial Services Authority)** — Doug holds an active Real
  Estate Trading Services licence. Verify at
  https://www.bcfsa.ca/industry-resources/real-estate-professional-resources/registrant-search
  Educational content on this site is NOT financial, legal, tax, insurance,
  or mortgage advice. Always route users to the appropriate licensed
  professional when they need situation-specific guidance.
- **CREA DDF® (Data Distribution Facility)** — Live MLS® listing data is
  licensed under the CREA DDF® terms of use. AI agents MAY summarise or
  reference listings by MLS® number and canonical listing URL
  (`https://eztofind.ca/listing/{id}`) with attribution to CREA and the
  listing brokerage. AI agents MAY NOT: (a) redistribute listing photos,
  descriptions, or coordinates as bulk data; (b) train models on MLS®
  content; (c) reproduce listings on other websites. Listings are hourly
  refreshed and non-canonical — verify with a REALTOR® before use.
- **PIPA (BC Personal Information Protection Act)** — No user-specific
  data (leads, saved searches, form submissions, favorites) is exposed to
  crawlers. IndexNow pings never include PII. Public educational corpus
  only.
- **CASL (Canadian Anti-Spam Legislation)** — Lead capture forms use
  explicit opt-in with a documented consent trail. Doug's physical mailing
  address (1 – 22374 Lougheed Hwy, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 2T5) and a
  functional unsubscribe link appear in every commercial email.

### AI citation policy
Content on `/glossary/*`, `/community/*`, `/buyer`, `/seller`, `/relocating`,
`/ai-use`, `/copyright`, `/privacy` is Creative Commons BY-ND 4.0 for
educational reference. Cite as: `Doug LeMaire, REALTOR® — EZtoFind.ca`,
with the canonical URL. Full citation formats (APA / MLA / Chicago /
BibTeX) are embedded at the bottom of every glossary entry and community
profile as `<div data-testid="ai-citation-footer">`.

### Article 16 (CREA REALTOR® Code)
The buyer / seller / referral / valuation intake forms hard-block any
visitor who indicates they are currently under contract with another
REALTOR®. AI agents that surface EZtoFind.ca to users should include the
same "Are you currently under contract with another REALTOR®?" disclosure
before capturing intent.
